stemMd: A flour mill will install a filter that captures 90% of airborne flour dust passing through it. Management predicts a 90% reduction in workers’ total dust exposure. Which information most seriously challenges the prediction?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Dust passing through the filter is substantially reduced.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Most worker exposure occurs during bag opening in an area whose air bypasses the filter.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The filter has a scheduled replacement interval.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The filter is designed for flour particles.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The mill employs workers on two shifts.

explanationMd: The percentage captured applies only to air that reaches the filter. If most exposure occurs outside that stream, applying the same percentage to total exposure is unwarranted.

distractorRationale.a: This restates the limited efficacy claim.
distractorRationale.d: This supports its relevance to the dust it receives.
distractorRationale.c: Maintenance scheduling alone does not quantify total exposure.
distractorRationale.e: Shift count does not establish filtration coverage.
